description: Defines constants, enums, structs, and functions related to PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) PDU processing, including size limits, header parsing, and formatting for debugging or logging.

classes.name: pdcp_data_pdu_header
classes.description: Represents the header of a PDCP Data PDU, containing a sequence number.

classes.name: pdcp_control_pdu_header
classes.description: Represents the header of a PDCP Control PDU, containing the control PDU type.

methods.name: to_number
methods.description: Converts pdcp_dc_field or pdcp_control_pdu_type enum values to their underlying integer representation.

methods.name: pdcp_pdu_get_dc
methods.description: Extracts the D/C (Data/Control) field from the first byte of a PDCP PDU.

methods.name: pdcp_control_pdu_get_cpt
methods.description: Extracts the control PDU type from the first byte of a PDCP control PDU.
